title: Experts disagree on existing stray changes
context:

Recommend stopping new strays and labelling the old ones plainly as paqad gaps, never as the user red; this meets the owner rule (repair or state as paqad gap) with no history rewrite. If the owner prefers folding, the idempotence fixture in the other claim becomes required.
